arms.name: offline-hard
arms.aux_loss: token mean hard target cross entropy

arms.name: offline-soft
arms.aux_loss: token mean full vocabulary forward KL teacher||student

arms.name: on-policy-soft
arms.teacher_prefixes: current student rollout sample 0 of current group, before any optimizer update
arms.aux_loss: token mean full vocabulary forward KL teacher||student

auxiliary.normalize: mean over active tokens within the selected trajectory
auxiliary.vocabulary: all 151936 output indices; no top-k renormalization

offline_cache.selection: first independently verified correct, nontruncated, complete reasoning response; no shortest selection
offline_cache.verification: existing math/choice verifier from pinned source snapshot
offline_cache.no_valid_teacher: omit auxiliary for this prompt in ALL arms; retain ordinary RL group; record coverage
offline_cache.on_policy_incorrect_or_truncated: score emitted prefix tokens including wrong/truncated output; never append synthetic EOS
offline_cache.identity: cache token IDs and full prompt IDs before any student training; no retokenization

contrasts.primary_mechanism: on-policy-soft minus offline-soft (same conditional KL, different prefix source)
contrasts.required_practical: on-policy-soft minus offline-hard (joint target/prefix difference, not pure mechanism evidence)

evaluation.split: existing tuning only; exploratory, already used
evaluation.caps: unchanged official per-dataset max_tokens, hashed in launch evaluation manifest
evaluation.baseline: fresh base and candidate on the same physical worker for EACH arm; pinned model/software/questions/decoding/seeds
evaluation.primary_metric: geometric mean across four domains of mean total generated token ratio; also pooled totals
evaluation.accuracy: macro mean across four domains; BFCL pooled by response count
evaluation.report: every arm/seed/domain, total/thinking tokens, generated/scored/trained tokens, teacher verification coverage, all costs, truncations, peak VRAM, wall time
evaluation.confirmation: none; historical confirmation is not untouched

decision.screening: continue only if token ratio <= .95 and macro accuracy delta >= -1pp versus offline-hard AND offline-soft; report all outcomes
decision.claim_noninferiority: paired 95% question-cluster bootstrap lower accuracy bound >= -1pp; bootstrap 10000 resamples seed 20261025; preserve all samples/arms per question
decision.token_uncertainty: paired question-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for total-token ratio; savings claim requires upper bound <1
decision.replication: all three seeds reported; seed-level variability separate from question CI; no confirmatory claim without fresh locked cohort

budget.reserve_with: existing cloud ledger lock, never a second scheduler
launch_checks: verify session authorization for concrete pilot
reconcile current ledger including API liabilities
confirm aggregate planned reservation within usable cap and pilot envelope
verify GPU allocation and actual student worker RTX 4090
budget.time_or_memory_failure: mark affected pair incomplete; no silent shortening, GPU substitution, or extra rental

hardware.teacher_inference: other hardware allowed; initial proposal co-resident on the same 4090
hardware.startup: use existing experiments.gpu_policy and trainer.verify_training_device; no model training on CPU
hardware.memory_smoke: measure 4B+student at 4096 sequence length batch 1, head chunks 32, student activation checkpointing, teacher use_cache false

provenance_required.link_rule: input IDs and masks identical, scoring_step == rollout policy_update for on-policy, no optimizer update before consumption

unresolved_launch_gates: shared trainer integration and integration tests
production package lock and evaluation cap hash
authorization/budget recheck and durable launch registration
